# DataFusion

> DataFusion is a Python desktop app that loads, cleans, encodes, scales and plots CSV datasets without code. Source, screenshots and setup guide.

## Pages

- [Project page](https://datafusion.dawidolko.pl/): Features, screenshots, bundled datasets, technology stack and setup steps.

## Source

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/dawidolko/DataFusion-App-Python): Python source, documentation and example datasets.
